name: B/CS Habitat for Humanity Pumpkin Patch
tagline: Pumpkin patch supports Habitat for Humanity’s affordable housing efforts in Bryan
description: B/CS Habitat for Humanity Pumpkin Patch is an agritourism farm in 301 E 29th Street, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
